summary: Iteration 4: Nearby tab feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_nearby_feed.py — /posts/feed?feed_type=nearby returns a 'distance' field (miles) on every post, results are sorted ascending by distance, radius filter honored (r=50 excludes Columbus which sits ~100.4mi from Cincinnati; r=150 includes it), no-lat/lng fallback correctly uses viewer's saved coords (maya=Cincinnati) and produces distance-annotated distance-sorted posts, city-string fallback for viewer with no coords + no matching-city posts (admin=Dublin) returns []. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as maya, tapped Nearby tab — permission-prompt card 'See pros near you' with 'Use my location' Pressable renders, 'Based on Cincinnati' status pill renders, radius chips 10/25/50/100 all present with 25 mi active by default, tapping chip 10 then 100 fires GET /api/posts/feed?feed_type=nearby&radius=10 and =100 (verified via request interception), 8 feed cards render. Admin (Dublin, no coords) Nearby tab renders 'Based on Dublin' + 'No pros nearby yet' empty state with 'Explore For You' CTA — matches spec exactly. Backend-frontend integration solid.

minor.issue: Cincinnati->Columbus haversine yields ~100.4mi, so a Columbus post is JUST outside a radius=100 chip selection. This is arithmetically correct, but the user-visible expectation for a '100 mi' chip may be that a ~100mi city is included. Consider snapping radius comparison to <= radius + small epsilon (e.g. 1mi) or bumping the chip label; not a functional bug.

issues: (pre-existing from iter 3) shadow* props deprecation warning still emitted by React Native Web on every screen load.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: any screen using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
React Native Web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents into style object.

action_items: (optional / minor) Consider treating the radius chip as inclusive at the label value (e.g. r=100 -> filter d <= 100.5 or d <= radius * 1.005) so a ~100.4mi Columbus post appears on the 100mi chip. Alternatively, adjust the Cincinnati/Columbus seed coords slightly to sit at ≤100mi if the desired UX is that Columbus surfaces at r=100.
(pre-existing) Migrate shadow* style props -> boxShadow (or Platform.OS==='web' guard) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: _nearby_feed (server.py:554) cleanly separates the two fallback paths (coords vs. city string) and correctly returns [] when neither is available — matches spec.
_post_coords helper falls back to the tagged professional's coordinates when the post itself lacks lat/lng — this makes the nearby filter robust for posts that inherit location from a tagged pro.
Radius filter uses d <= radius which is strict; combined with the exact haversine calc, boundary cases (~radius mi) may feel unexpected to end users (see minor issue above).

Frontend index.tsx correctly re-runs load() via useCallback dep on [activeTab, coords, radiusMi], so both radius chip taps and permission-grant coord updates trigger a fresh /posts/feed fetch. Verified via network intercept.
NearbyControls correctly gates the 'Based on <city>' status on locState==='prompt'||'blocked' — will NOT show once permission is granted (replaced by 'Using your current location'). Good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 spec items verified — permission card, 'Based on <city>', radius chips render with 25mi active, chip tap refetches feed, empty state with prompt

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Tests read only from existing seed (maya/admin/kay/pro accounts and their posts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nearby tab feature is production-ready. If retesting, note that the seeded Columbus post sits at ~100.4mi from Cincinnati — this is why r=50 excludes it (correct) and why r=100 chip does NOT include it (mathematically correct but potentially unexpected UX). Tests use r=150 to assert 'Columbus is included beyond 100mi'. Frontend can be re-verified quickly with maya (should show 8 posts + 'Based on Cincinnati' + prompt card since web permission is 'prompt') and admin (should show 'No pros nearby yet' + 'Based on Dublin').
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature working as specified. Only minor UX consideration around the r=100 chip boundary (see backend_issues.minor).
